Evidence & completeness

No estimate is presented as an imported record. These are source-backed 2026 bridge observations, not continuously updated inspections.

Oregon reconciliation: The official FHWA total represents 8,325 G/F/P classified records. Its state JSON contains one additional N-coded record, which we retain and identify separately. This is a classification discrepancy, not evidence of a dangerous bridge.
Evidence limits. Historical ratings can be stale and should not be used for route clearance. County attribution only uses reported field BL02. One Oregon record marked N remains unclassified rather than being erased or forced into a condition grade. State files are cited individually. No real-time official emergency feed is connected. This standalone preview runs offline once opened; it is not a public deployment.
